blocking_findings_resolved.problem: An early state failure left the call-info lane occupied; the next load wrapped a rejected lane admission in an unsettled Promise.
blocking_findings_resolved.resolution: Each load owns and retires its own request handle in finally; a rejected lane admission settles immediately.

checks: Native and watchdog timeout order settles once; timer and handlers retire.
Old cancelled XHR cannot publish again or clear a successor lane.
Early sibling failure releases only the owning load request.
Pagehide cancellation and old finally preserve a new page generation request.
Only call-info is migrated; state/locale/heartbeat scheduling remains separate planned work.
limitations: 14 host Web test scripts execute production modules with controlled browser boundaries.
Browser interaction blocked by open Chrome extension UI; IAB disconnected.
Old Safari/WebView devices and physical actions are not qualified.
